decision.rationale: TXN-008031 (10576 EUR minor units, QUAYSIDE CLOTHING, MER-000042) is on card CRD-000046 and posted on 2026-08-22. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-25, 64 days later, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation AUTH-008228 shows entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure AUTHENTICATED, CVV MATCH, response APPROVED and fraud flag false. Under unauthorised-3ds-authenticated, an online payment authenticated with 3-D Secure and with no fraud flag counts as made by the cardholder, and the matching CVV supports this. The card has no earlier transactions at this merchant: the disputed one is the only one, so that check neither supports nor weakens the decline. The cardholder says the card stayed with them, but this does not change the result because the card itself does not need to be present for an online payment that the cardholder confirmed with 3-D Secure.

proposed_actions.reason: The online payment of 105.76 EUR to QUAYSIDE CLOTHING on 2026-08-21 was confirmed through the bank's 3-D Secure check, and the card's security code was entered correctly. Our fraud screening did not mark it as suspicious. Under our policy, a payment confirmed this way is treated as made by the cardholder, so we can't uphold the dispute.
